items.title: Does KV residency change the numbers at fixed capacity?
items.question: Strata pinned at --kv int8 --max-context 65536 --resident-budget-gib 2, --kv-resident versus --kv-streaming: do the answers move, or only the rate?
items.prediction: Letters unchanged; rate better with residency; if letters move, determinism outranks speed.
items.instrument: engine cold/warm rates plus ledger (70 checks) plus knowledge_deep --forms reason (93 letters)

items.title: Ladder --moe-cache-mib on the staged b11480 build
items.question: On --cpu-moe Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Q4_K_M with 12 GB VRAM, what does each rung buy?
items.prediction: Non-monotonic, peaking in the low thousands of MiB: 0 -> ~35-40 tok/s, a rung at 256-2048 best, the top rung at or below the control.
items.instrument: ledger + ledger2 (the cache changes numerics, so speed alone is not a result) and the engine decode rate
items.staged: ai_bench/staged-llamacpp-b11480 (build 11480, commit d6cf9acb2; control b11461 has no such flag)

items.title: A per-workload noise floor before trusting any tune
items.question: How much do two identical runs differ, in wall time and in checks?
items.prediction: Small in checks for the deterministic tasks, large enough in wall time to swallow a 5% speed claim.
items.instrument: the same config run twice, scored identically

items.title: Warm the expert cache from a calibrated hot set at fixed capacity
items.question: Our 2026-10-11 warm test warmed with prompts and persisted nothing; does a calibrated hot set raise the hit rate and move decode, and does it move the letters?
items.prediction: Hit rate up (toward the 42% the calibration literature reports from 6% random) and decode better; letters unchanged.
items.instrument: ledger2 plus the engine's own hit-rate line, capacity fixed

items.title: Ollama 0.40.4's native decision-model path

items.prediction: Catch rate stays 0/4 (the model is the failure, now measured on two engines); latency nearer Colibri's 1.7-2.1 s median than our 27.56 s p95.
items.note: installed Ollama is already 0.40.4, so no upgrade is needed
